Power Stations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
 every two months and depending on external leakage as indicated by M2 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Abd El Naeim 
 Attallah Ahmed, accepted by eng. 
 Gomah Lotfy general director, revised by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil; EDEPC 
 quality control general director, and approved by eng. Mokhter Abd 
 Elatif: head sector of Ataka Power Station (2x300+2x150) MW.
This 
 document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & 
 inspection and quality control general director, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Mohamed Solman EDEPC Admin. & financial inspection, quality 
 control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control 
 head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified staff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety glass 
 ... etc.
Boiler out of service and pressure should be zero.
Vents opened.
Provide the working area by a good lighting.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety glass 
 ... etc.
Boiler out of service and pressure should be zero.
Vents opened.
Drain all boiler walls and super heaters, re-heaters and economizer.
Provide the working area by a good lighting.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Grind and grinding wheel.
Selected filler metal for TIG welding (Argon) and suitable weld wire.
Welding machine.
Suitable lifting device.
Work to be Carried out
Before Shut down Boiler
Check 
 quantity of feeding water and quantity of steam on chart of control room
Check 
 any leakage for pipes of super heater, reheaters, suspension tube, walls and 
 economizer.
Check 
 drum water level on chart at control room.
After 
Shut down Boiler
Be sure 
 the feed water out operation
Check 
 the pressure in side boiler (all walls) equal zero.
Be sure 
 walls drum, super heaters and re-heaters drained opened.
Vents 
 opened.
Be sure 
 the forced drought fan and recercule.
Ensure that the tion fan out of service and isolated
Inspection the Defected 
Pipes
Clean 
 every part wall before any inspection.
Operate 
 the feed pump to increase pressure boiler from 0 to 10 bar and check any water 
 leaks.
Check 
 all pipes to find damage and remark on it.
Repair the Defected 
Pipes
After finding out 
 of the place of failure pipes.
Remove the fixing 
 part as the suspension and bonds.
Cut out the 
 damage pipes.
Grind the edges 
 to be ready for welding.
New pipes should 
 be prepared to be replaced.
The length of 
 replaced pipe must not be less than 250mm in the straight part of the part.
The weld must be 
 chosen in the way ensuring the distance from the part welded to the pipe min 
 20mm.
After success 
 fully welding, repeats the pressure again and check again.
